mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT VALUES (SEQ_REPORT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{reportReason}, #{reportDetail}, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, #{reporterMemberNo}, #{reportedMemberNo})
mapper.select: SELECT r.REPORT_NO, r.REPORT_DETAIL, reporter.MEMBER_NICKNAME REPORTER_NICKNAME, reported.MEMBER_NICKNAME REPORTED_NICKNAME, r.REPORT_REASON, TO_CHAR(REPORT_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') REPORT_DATE FROM REPORT r JOIN MEMBER reporter ON (r.REPORTER_MEMBER_NO = reporter.MEMBER_NO) JOIN MEMBER reported ON (r.REPORTED_MEMBER_NO = reported.MEMBER_NO) WHERE r.REPORT_STATUS = 'PENDING'
